# sigma_user_attributes (Data Source)

Lists Sigma user attributes. Results preserve Sigma API order; key collections by returned IDs rather than positional indices. Pagination cursors and page sizes are not exposed; this data source retrieves every page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_user_attributes" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name filter (`name`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.
- `user_attributes` (Attributes List) User attributes in API order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_attributes))

<a id="nestedatt--user_attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_attributes`

Read-Only:

- `default_value` (String) Default string value.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) User attribute ID.
- `name` (String) Name.
